name: Youth & Family Services Bureau (City of Hayward)
description: Free counseling, crisis intervention and family case management, run by the City inside the Police Department building. Drop in or call. Mon–Thu 9a–7p, Fri 9a–5:30p.

name: REACH Ashland Youth Center
description: County youth center with a health clinic and therapy, plus recreation, arts, education and career programs.

name: Tennyson High School Health Center (TVHC)
description: Confidential teen health care on campus: mental health care, sports physicals, immunizations, STI testing. Room A-1.

name: Hayward High School Health Center (TVHC)
description: Confidential teen health care on campus, including mental health care.

name: Castro Valley High Health Center (TVHC)
address: 19400 Santa Maria Ave, Castro Valley, CA 94546
description: Student and community health center on campus: primary care, sports physicals, confidential services. CVHS also has a Wellness Center for counseling.

name: San Lorenzo High School Health Center (La Clínica)
address: 50 E Lewelling Blvd, San Lorenzo, CA 94580
ages: Students at San Lorenzo, Arroyo & Sunset High
description: Medical care, reproductive health, sports physicals, health education and behavioral health services.

name: La Familia Counseling Service
description: Individual and family therapy for children and youth; bilingual (English/Spanish) services.

name: Project Eden (Horizon Services)
description: Youth substance use counseling and prevention. Horizon also runs the Lambda Drop-In Center for LGBTQIA+ youth; call for its location and hours.

name: Our Space – LGBTQ+ Youth Center (Side by Side)
description: Drop-in LGBTQ+ community center in downtown Hayward. Side by Side (formerly Bay Area Youth Center) also offers mental health services for transition-age and foster youth.

name: Community Hub at the Downtown Library
description: Drop-in, one-stop help on the library's 2nd floor. Partners on a rotating schedule include Youth & Family Services, Horizon, Eden Youth and Hayward Promise Neighborhoods.

name: Wilma Chan Family Resource Center (SLZUSD)
description: San Lorenzo Unified's family resource center: food distribution, playgroups and family support.

name: HUSD Parent Resource Center (The HUB)
description: Hayward Unified's family hub: parent groups such as Cafe Dad, the backpack giveaway and resource fairs.

name: Eden Youth & Family Center – Computer Clubhouse
description: Free after-school tech clubhouse: homework help, coding, music and media projects, plus job readiness. Mon–Thu 1–6p.

name: Hijos del Sol Youth Leadership (La Familia)
description: Youth leadership development program at La Familia's Neighborhood Resource Center.

name: Salvation Army Hayward Corps – Youth Programs
description: After-school drop-in with homework help, a computer/tutoring center and dinner.

name: Girls Inc. of Alameda County
description: Leadership, education and fitness programs for girls, summer programs, and counseling through Pathways Counseling Center.

name: Deputy Sheriffs' Activities League (DSAL)
description: Youth sports, boxing, the Dig Deep Farm program and youth leadership for Ashland, Cherryland and San Lorenzo.
